info.title: Longbridge Quote Gateway
info.description: Read-only single-instance gateway. Decimal values are strings. Cache TTL defaults to 60 seconds. Historical results reaching 1000 rows may be truncated. Unknown parameters and URL tokens are rejected.

schema.description: Comma separated symbols; limit applies before deduplication; default maximum 50.
